newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Brittan says Singapore meeting boosts WTO strength.
newsitem.headline: Brittan says Singapore meeting boosts WTO strength.

text.p: European Trade Commisisoner Sir Leon Brittan said on Friday this week's ministerial meeting of the World Trade Organisation had boosted the strength and profile of the trade body.
"We regard the conference as having been a huge international success which has given vital boost to the strength and profile of the World Trade Organisation," Brittan told a news conference.

Delegates at this week's first WTO ministerial conference, which ends today, successfully concluded an Information Technology Agreement to eliminate tariffs on computers, software and other information products by 2000.

Ministers from the 128 nations of the WTO were on Friday putting the seal on a sweeping pact to free up commerce in $600 billion information technology market and set the agenda of world trade talks for the rest of the century.
